description: The bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment” illustrates the runtime (in seconds) for a set of models, contrasting “Our Joint Framework” with several “LLM Models.” The horizontal axis contains the model categories in left-to-right order: Our Joint Framework, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude, with labels angled diagonally; no explicit x-axis label is shown. The vertical axis is labeled “Runtime (seconds)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 with regularly spaced tick marks at 50-second intervals. There are five single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: “Our Joint Framework” is shown in dark green at approximately 77 seconds (value annotated “77” above the bar), while the LLM model bars are light blue with black outlines—ChatGPT at about 190 seconds (annotated “190”), DeepSeek at about 365 seconds (annotated “365”), LLaMA at about 172 seconds (annotated “172”), and Claude at about 243 seconds (annotated “243”). A legend in the upper-left indicates the color mapping (green for “Our Joint Framework,” blue for “LLM Models”), and the bars appear in the listed category order rather than being sorted by value; no bars are otherwise specially emphasized beyond the numeric annotations.
